visualCharacteristics: Horizontally-scrolling case-study gallery on a dark background. Each card is a tall image with a client eyebrow label and title overlaid. Prev/next circular arrow buttons scroll the track one card at a time.
contentPattern: First row labels the block ('Cards'). Each case study is one row with two cells: cell 1 = image, cell 2 = client eyebrow + title (heading) + optional link.
usage: 'Our work in action' case-study / client-story gallery carousel.
